content: Yesun parunu tharadhin Pilathoniya

Mina bathaynga nanga thana kuyku misnaren mina sobaginga garwoeydhamoeydhin. Thanamuniya kalmel yoewthaw koey mabaygal a sabiw ngurpay mabaygal a dhuray wara koey mabaygal, mura thanamun Yoewdhayalgaw kawnselaw mabaygal. Thana garwoeydhamoeydhin ya umamoeypa, Yesulpa mathamoeypa. Thana Yesun urukamin aymoedhin a yoelpaydhin nuyn Pilatholpa.
Pilatho nuyn yapu poeybadhin kedha, ‘Ngi Mina Yoewdhayalgaw Kuykulnga a?’ Yesu kuniya kedha mulaydhin, ‘Wa, nginu yangukudu moegina balbayginga.’
Thana kuyku misnaren nuyn kasa mina koeyma mulamoeyr.
Pilatho lak yapu poeybadhin nubepa, ‘Ngi midh paru thanamulpa kuniya ya mulayginga, nagi thana mura wati za ngibiya woeydhoeypa?’
Yesu kasa ngaru yagig. Nuy Pilatho dan kathamaydhin kedha, nuy Yesu midh paru kuniya yagig.
Nungu Pilathon pawa kedha, mura Kaludhay Ayngu thonara nanga, nuydh ngulayg mabaygaw ubilnga kunumayzi mabayg pa wayan.
Senawbi thonara nanga wara mabayg Barabas muynu kunumay lagoenu, minguz kedha nuy koey kawragil mabayg, wara thonara nuy koey silamaynu muynu Yoerusalemoenu, a wara mabayg nuydh uma mathamoedhin.
Mabaygan garwoeydhamoeydhin a yapu poeybemidhin Pilatholpa kedha, ‘Ngi kay pa woeyaypa ngoeymulpa urapun mabayg kulay midh nanga.’
Nuy yapu poeybiz thanamulpa kedha, ‘Ngithamun ubi midh, Yoewdhayalgaw Mopakuyk ngithamulpa pa woeyaypa a?’
Minguz kedha, nuy Pilatho mina koey ngulayg kedha, thana yoewthaw koey mabaygal kasa uwan memayidhin, thana kedha zoenguz Yesun kotoepa madhin.
Kasa kay kedha thana kuyku misnarel mulaydhin mabaygoepa kedha, ‘Ngitha kedha wal mamayi, “Barabasan kay ngoeymulpa ngapa pa wayar”.’ Thana Yesulpa wal mayginga. Thana Barabasoelpa walmemayir.
Pilatho kedha yapu poeybadhin thanamulpa, ‘Kedha kay nanga, wa ngath kay miza ayimpa nubepa ngan nanga ngitha kedha thuraypu Yoewdhayalgaw Mopakuyk?’
Thana kedha wal memayir, ‘Sathawro puydhaw nuyn.’
Nuy kay Pilatho kedha umay thanamulpa, ‘Mipa kay nuyn sathawro puydhaypa, nuydh za miyay gegeyadh aymoenu?’ Thana na kay zizigi moeyngu mina gegeyadh wal memayir kedha, ‘Sathawro puydhaw nuyn.’

Pilathon ubi nuydh mabaygaw ngoenakapul balbayg palepa. Nuydh Barabasan pa wayadhin thanamulpa, kasa kay kedha nuydh Yesun nungu koewbu mabaygoepa gud aradhin poelngipa, kalanu sathawro puydhaypa madhin.
Koewbu mabaygan Yesun giwn madhin
Thana koewbu mabaygan Yesun muya thayadhin gabmenaw lagiya.
A thana thuradhin mura thanamun koewbu mabaygal.

Kasa nubepa giwn maypa thana bamagadh gamul koey sodh Yesuniya angadhin. Minguz kedha, sena matha mopakuyku oengay gamul dhoemawak. Thana nubepa patal puyngu ngoelkay korone aymoedhin a nungu kuykuya angadhin.
Kalanu thana nuyn mina gegeyadh giwn soelmar kedha, ‘Ngaru Igilil Mopakuyk Yoewdhayalgaw.’
Thana nuyn boegin kuyk tidar, a parupa mosan tidar. Thana nubeya parunu kulun pasoenoemoeyr.
Thanamun nanga giwnsoelmay muwasin, thana kalanu bamagadh gamul rugan thudhan a nungu geth rugan kay kuniya ubaman. Kalanu thana adhapa yoelpadhin nuyn, sathawro puydhaypa.
Yesun sathawro puydhadhin neylan
Senawbi thonara urapun mabayg nungu maboenu woelmay, nungu nel Simona, Sayrinoelayg nuy, Alesandoerom a Rupoesom thathi. Thana apasiginga nuyn gasamoedhin Yesun sathawropa thoeridhoeypa.
Thana Yesun adhapa madhin padoepa, nel Golgotha. Ngalpadh kedha Kuyku Sibuy.
Thana nubepa nuthan madhin umal ngukiw a theral za garwoeydhamoeyzinga muynu. Senabi theral za nel mer. Kasa kay kedha Yesu ubigasidhin woenile.
Kalanu thana nuyn sathawro puydhadhin neylan a nungu gamu rugal thanamuniya dhadh mamayidhin. Thana days thayar imaypa kedha ngadh kay gasamaypa mi dhoemawakul.
Senawbi bathaynga nayn koelokoenu thana nuyn sathawro puydhadhin nanga,
thana nubeya yangukudulnga za wanadhin gimal kuyku laganu kedha yadaynga, ‘Yoewdhayalgaw Mopakuyk.’
Nubeya wara ukasar wadhwadhgam sathawro poeydhamoedhin ukasar mina koey geth geth puru kaz mabayg. Wara getha doegamoenu wara boedha doegamoenu.
Mabaygal ngaya nanga sike pasiya tadir, thana kasa kuyk woerimoeyr kedha umamoeyr, ‘Ngidh ngulayg idiman Awgadhaw lag, yoewth a lak moeydhan thoeri goeygiw kaliya a?
Midh paru ngi nginungu balbayg tidayginga a? Ngapa mulupa pagar seyzi sathawrowngu nginu igililnga kuykuthal palal.’
Thana koey misnarel a yoewthaw sabiw ngurpay mabaygal lak kedha nuyn giwn soelmar kedha, ‘Nuydh wara mabaygal gudaz pudhepa, kasa kay kedha nuy nungu geth ibupuydhayginga.’

‘Nuy kedha mulaydhin, nuy Keriso, Isoereylaw Kuykulnga. Ngalpa kay imaypa, nuy kay nanga nungu geth mulupa poegaypa, wa ngoey kay nubepa mina yoepathamoeypa.’ A sepal ngawal nanga nubeya wadhwadhgam sathawro puydhamoedhin, palay lak nuyn giwn mar.
Yesun kuth gasamoedhin
Dhadha goeyginu nanga mura wadhwadhgam inur thoeydhamoeydhin, senabi koey goegathoenu kurusipa thoeri klok.
Kalanu Yesu koey gimiya wal miyaydhin thanamudh kedha, ‘Eli, Eli lema sabakthani?’ Muynu kedha, ‘Ngaw Awgadh, ngaw Awgadh, ngidh mingu ngoena kasa wananu?’
Dhuray mabaygal si pasinu sir thana karngemidhin, thana kedha mulemidhin, ‘Nuy Peropethoepa Elayzalpa wal mepa sikedh.’

Urapun mabayg thanamulngu zilamiz sathawropa a spanz sobaginga sisaberal ngukinu muynu thardhan, kalanu puy kopin pagan Yesulpa yoewdhan nubepa woenipa a kedha mulaydhin, ‘Thumaka mamu ugaypa, nuydh kay sikedh peropetha Elayza nuyn mulupa maypa sathawrowngu.’
Senawbi thonara Yesu gimiya wal miyaydhin, nungu moeygoepa guban,
a koey yoewthanu thanamun wulaw koey dhoemawak
nanu geth pakadamoeydhin gimanakaz mulupa.
Nuy koewbu kuyku mabayg nanga imadhin kedha, Yesu midh paru nanga muwasidhin gimal sathawronu, nuy kedha mulaydhin, ‘In nubi mabayg nuy mina Awgadhaw Kazi.’
Dhuray si memayir yoepkazil, thana moegina sigaz nagemir. Thanamuniya kalmel Mariya Magdalangu, a Salome a wara Mariya na moegina Zemes a Yoewsepa, palamun apu.
Thana nubeya kalmel Yesu na Galilayoenu mer, a ibupuydhar nuyn, aymoeyr mura nungu ubilmayl. A matha kedha dhuray yoepkazil nubeya ngaya nanga Yoerusalemoepa asimoeydhin, thana lak si mamayir.
Yesun moeramathayadhin

Wara koey mabayg thanamuniya, thanamun Yoewdhayalgaw kawnselaw mabayg, nungu nel Yoewsepa, Aramathiyalayg. Nuy lak mina kapu akasizi mabayg, nuydh ugar Awgadhaw Basalayaw mangay thonar. Thanamun za buthapoethay goeyga kutoepa nanga sabadhaw paru, nuy Yoewsepa mina akaginga Pilatholpa pa uzaraydhin a yapu poeybaydhin Yesun gamupa. Nuy thanamun sabadhoengu kikimidhin.
Yoewsepa Pilathon madhu paman nuy nanga Yesun gamu lumar. Nuydh Pilatho koewbu kuyku mabayg thuran a kalanu yapu poeybiz kedha, ‘Yesu mina kulkub um mema?’
Mura nanga karngemidhin koewbu kuyku mabaygaw yangukudu nanga Pilatho kalanu Yoewsepalpa wa madhin kedha, nubepa gamu maypa, Yesun gamu.

Nuydh Yoewsepa mina kapu goerab gamul dhoemawak barpudhadhin, Yesun gamu mulupa madhin, a senabi kayn dhoemawakun nuradhin. Kalanu kulaw sakaynu muynu aradhin, sena mi sakay nanga kulangu adhapa pamadhin. Mura na muwasidhin nuydh mina koey kula gawan thayadhin parunu senabi sakay gudanu.
Mariya Magdala a wara Mariya, Yoewsepan apu, palay yawayar Yesun gamu ngalaga nanga wanadhin.

footnotes.text: Nuy Pilatho thanamun Romaniw mura zagethaw danal poethay mabayg.

Dhuray kulkubaw Minar Poelayzimay l, thana wara basalmayl kedha 28. Yesu kuniya mulaydhin, ‘Ngi mina yoepathamayzi apu! Wa, ngibepa ayman, matha kedha ngin ubilnga midh.’ Balbayginga senabi thonara, nanu yoepkaz kazi balbaygoesidhin.
Thanamun wulaw koey dhoemawak, na koertoen.
